gates.title: UmiPOS application foundation
gates.objective: Create the Flutter application shell, consume the generated Dart contract, establish secure environment handling, localization, accessibility, and CI boundaries.

gates.title: Device trust and authenticated context
gates.objective: Implement device enrollment, secure credential storage, revocation, operator session, tenant context, and branch binding through UMI APIs.

gates.title: Read-only catalog vertical
gates.objective: Add canonical catalog, pricing, tax, availability, media, and pagination contracts and a read-only POS browsing slice.

gates.title: Authoritative sale command vertical
gates.objective: Implement one online sale path with server totals, optimistic versioning, idempotency, audit, receipt snapshot, and explicit payment-boundary states.

gates.title: Offline journal and operational recovery
gates.objective: Implement encrypted local command journaling, ordering, replay resistance, reconciliation, provisional mapping, recovery UI, and bounded synchronization.
